name: VITRO Makati 1 and 2 (ePLDT/PLDT)
notes: VITRO Makati 2 is ePLDT's flagship, first PH data center with ANSI/TIA-942 Rated 3 Facilities certification; DataCenterMap lists 16 MW. VITRO Makati 1 provides 580 sqm data hall space. Operational carrier-neutral colocation in Makati (NCR); Meralco-served. A for operator/official; 16 MW from directory (C/B-), keep as marketed.

name: VITRO Pasig (ePLDT)
notes: VITRO Pasig operational since 2000 (Canley Road corner C.P. Garcia Ave, Pasig, NCR); PeeringDB lists 30 networks/5 local exchanges; continuous operation confirmed by ePLDT-Schneider Electric transformation coverage. Capacity not published - null.

name: VITRO Parañaque (ePLDT)
notes: VITRO Parañaque operational colocation facility in Parañaque (NCR) with NOC monitoring, managed hosting, cloud and DR services. A for operator listing; capacity null.

name: Equinix MN1, MN2, MN3 (ex-TIM Manila data centers)
developer: Equinix (acquired from Total Information Management, June 2025)
notes: Equinix completed acquisition of three TIM Manila data centers (MN1/MN2/MN3) in June 2025: >1,000 cabinets (MN2 alone 500), host several key Manila internet exchanges, land for expansion; MN1 at Purificacion St Carmona/Macaria Business Center, MN3 at 5600 Osmeña Hwy Makati. A for Equinix release/directory confirmation; cabinets >1000, MW not published (null).

name: STT GDC Makati (STT Makati DC)
notes: STT GDC Makati at 2275-2281 Chino Roces Ave, Makati (NCR), prime business district colocation. Globe newsroom confirms STT GDC Philippines AI-ready expansion. A for operator evidence; capacity null (individual site MW not published).

name: STT Fairview campus (STT Fairview 1, Quezon City)
notes: STT Fairview 1 (Quezon City, NCR) announced ready for service Q2 2025; first data hall level fully occupied, second level being commissioned, more floors in development (Aug 2026 context.ph); campus target 124 MW IT across 4 buildings / 83,000 sqm (Beeinfotech 'The Hive' is part of this campus). 124 MW is planned campus target (marketed), not operating MW.

name: Converge ICT Manila data center (Reliance IT Center, Pasig)
notes: Converge ICT operates enterprise colocation facility at Reliance IT Center, 99 Eulogio Rodriguez Jr. Ave, Ugong, Pasig (NCR); directories (datacenters.com, colomap) confirm. A planned Converge data center in Quezon City reported by Baxtel (status unverified). Capacity null.

name: AWS Manila Local Zone + Direct Connect (ePLDT Makati node)
developer: Amazon Web Services (hosted in ePLDT/VITRO Makati facility)
notes: AWS Manila Local Zone launched June 19, 2023 (ap-southeast-1-mnl-1a); AWS Direct Connect 100G/10G with MACsec expanded Oct 2025 at existing DX location in ePLDT data center near Makati (NCR). This is cloud edge/DX infrastructure, NOT a full AWS PH Region (none exists); physical node hosted in ePLDT Makati 2 infrastructure (B/C for exact node).

name: DITO Clark Super Core Data Center (Clark Global City, Mabalacat)
notes: DITO broke ground Apr 2021 on Clark Global City (Mabalacat, Pampanga, Central Luzon): 8-hectare development with NOC, call center, regional center, R&D lab; Meinhardt confirms 700 cabinets, 4 MW total power, 7,500 sqm modular prefabricated shockproof design; Baxtel lists as operational. 4 MW from contractor project page (B), A for DCD+directory confirmation of facility.

name: VITRO Clark (ePLDT, Clark Freeport Zone)
notes: VITRO Clark (Lot 3, Ninoy Aquino Ave, Clark Freeport Zone, Angeles) is ePLDT's 9th data center, first TIA-942 Rated 3 facility outside Metro Manila; largest ePLDT DC outside Metro Manila per OCOLO. A for operator/directory. Capacity null.

name: VITRO Subic (ePLDT, Subic Bay Freeport Zone)
notes: VITRO Subic at Building 60, Sampson Rd, Subic Bay Freeport Zone (Zambales, Central Luzon); OCOLO lists 0.5 MW power capacity, ~45 racks per Baxtel. Small legacy facility; A for operator/directory evidence.

name: Converge ICT Clark data center
notes: Baxtel Pampanga market page lists Converge ICT Clark, Pampanga with 10 MW - largest DC in Pampanga per directory. Directory-only evidence; needs operator confirmation (C per methodology).

name: New Clark City data center zone (BCDA/Filinvest Innovation Park)
notes: New Clark City (Tarlac/Capas, Central Luzon) Innovation Park zoned for data center operations businesses (Wikipedia/Bridges Magazine); Narra Technology Park positioned as digital-infrastructure zone. BCDA clarified Aug 2026 that Pax Silica land will NOT host hyperscale data centers (semicon focus) - so DC zone is a planned zoning lead, no specific facility confirmed. C grade.

name: VITRO Sta. Rosa (ePLDT, Pulong Santa Cruz, Laguna)
notes: VITRO Sta. Rosa (VSR) at Tagaytay-Balibago Rd, Brgy Pulong Sta. Cruz, Santa Rosa, Laguna (CALABARZON): PH's first AI-ready hyperscale data center, inaugurated by President Marcos Apr 2025; first phase ~10 MW, expandable to 50 MW-class on 5-hectare site; dedicated substation; TIA-942 Rated 3. 50 MW is marketed/planned campus power (OCOLO 50 MW); DCD reports phase 1 ~10MW operational.

name: SpaceDC MNL1 (Cainta, Rizal)
notes: SpaceDC MNL1 in Cainta, Rizal (CALABARZON): 72 MW hyperscale green campus (43,000 sqm, 3-4 buildings), Philippines' largest DC campus per operator; DCD 2022 reported scheduled opening that year. Status operational per operator site (verify phase status with SpaceDC/EMB/LGU); 72 MW is marketed critical power.

name: STT Cavite campus (STT Cavite 1 & 2, General Trias)
notes: STT Cavite (4-hectare, General Trias, Cavite, CALABARZON): Phase 1 (STT Cavite 2 first phase) operational per Inquirer Aug 2026 and context.ph; STT Cavite 1 Phase 1 expected Q1 2026 per Baxtel; Phase 2 construction underway; STT Cavite 2 rated 6 MW IT load. Marked construction overall with partial operation; 6 MW per directory.

name: Flow/A-FLOW ML1 data center (Biñan, Laguna)
developer: A-FLOW (AyalaLand Logistics Holdings Corp + FLOW Digital Infrastructure/PAG)
notes: A-FLOW ML1 in Biñan, Laguna (CALABARZON): three-building campus up to 36 MW IT load; initial 6 MW ready for service end-2024, officially launched Nov 28, 2025 (A-FLOW newsroom). 36 MW is campus total; phase 1A 6 MW operational.

name: DAMAC Digital / EDGNEX Laguna AI data center
notes: DAMAC Digital (EDGNEX) met President Marcos Jan 13-14, 2026 re planned Laguna AI data center - reported as PH's largest at 250 MW (AI Data Center Index). MoU/presidential-meeting stage per methodology: planned/MoU-level B/C until LGU/EMB/utility/PEZA/BOI/operator facility evidence appears. 250 MW is announced target.

name: VITRO Cebu 1 & 2 (ePLDT, Mandaue City)
notes: VITRO Cebu 1 & 2 at A.S. Fortuna St, Mandaue City, Cebu (Central Visayas; batch division Central Visayas, current PSGC: Cebu remains Region VII): first commercial DC in region; VITRO Cebu 2 (TIA-942 registered) hosts ePLDT's first Visayas DR facility (2021); Baxtel lists VITRO Cebu 2 at 3 MW / 16,458 sqft. A for operator/certification evidence.

name: STT GDC Davao DC1 (Davao City)
notes: STT Davao DC1 on Gen. Douglas MacArthur Hwy, Talomo, Davao City (Davao Region): directly connected to US via SEA-US submarine cable. A for operator/directory evidence; capacity null.

name: VITRO Davao (ePLDT)
notes: PLDT VITRO Davao launched 2017 with 44 racks / ~1.1k sqft per Baxtel (operated by ePLDT). Confirmed alongside VITRO Clark inauguration coverage. A for operator evidence; capacity null (racks noted in notes).

name: Converge Bifrost cable landing station (Davao City)
notes: Converge CLS for Bifrost Cable System in Davao City (745 sqm, owned/operated by Converge, PH gateway for Bifrost); construction started Feb 2023; Converge completed national digital infrastructure incl. new Davao International CLS by Mar 2026 (Dot Daily Dose). Connectivity anchor per methodology - NOT a colocation datacenter; recorded for completeness.

name: North Luzon Data Center (Camp John Hay, Baguio)
developer: DICT with BCDA and John Hay Management Corp (JHMC)
notes: DICT-BCDA-JHMC partnership signed Sep 18, 2023 for North Luzon Data Center at Camp John Hay, Baguio (CAR) as part of National Government Data Center program; MB Jan 2025 reaffirms partnership. Government facility - A for official partnership; status announced/planning (no construction/operation confirmed); capacity null.

name: PLDT La Union Cable Landing Station (Bauang)
notes: PLDT operates La Union cable landing station (Bauang) - connectivity anchor, NOT a colocation datacenter per methodology; recorded for completeness of Ilocos coverage. No commercial DC verified in Ilocos.

name: Converge La Union cable landing station
notes: Converge completed La Union cable landing station as part of national digital infrastructure (Mar 2026). Connectivity anchor, not a datacenter; recorded for Ilocos completeness.
